name: Bowen Bridge
connectingPointsDisplay: East Derwent Highway — Brooker Highway (Goodwood Road)
facts: The Bowen Bridge, unveiled by Prime Minister Bob Hawke on 23 February 1984, cost $49 million and spans eight 109‑metre segments, with end spans of 48 and 56 metres.
Engineered to withstand a 1,600‑tonne barge impact at 45°, the bridge’s 13.3‑metre‑diameter caisson piers extend 48 metres below mean sea level, absorbing massive forces.
Named after John Bowen, the bridge links Hobart’s eastern and western shores, connecting the East Derwent Highway to the Brooker Highway (Goodwood Road) across the Derwent.
